data.description:
## Description

**What**: Single-writer contract for dso-id label operations across applier leaves. Document and enforce which leaf owns dso-id label ops per direction x scenario. inbound_clean_label removes stale dso-id labels (draft-2); repair_property writes dso_local_id property when label exists (draft-6); per-element provenance skips dso-id labels (draft-9). Unit test matrix + contract test + static guard with DsoIdLabelWriteError.
**Why**: Three stories touch dso-id semantics; without shared contract, draft-9 provenance could accidentally propose dso-id writes; draft-6 repair could collide with draft-2 cleanup mid-pass.
**Scope**:
- IN: Contract doc (or in-code docstrings), 9-leaf x dso-id-write unit test matrix, conflict_resolver contract test, applier static guard with DsoIdLabelWriteError
- OUT: Reorganization of identity primitives; new label types

## Done Definitions

- A contract document or in-code docstring documents which leaf owns dso-id label writes per direction x scenario: inbound_clean_label removes stale dso-id labels (draft-2); repair_property writes dso_local_id property when label is present (draft-6); per-element provenance skips dso-id labels entirely (draft-9) ← Satisfies: sc-1, sc-7
- A unit test matrix asserts that NO applier leaf writes a dso-id label except inbound_clean_label (deletion) and explicit-bind paths (outbound_create); cover all 9 applier leaves with one test per leaf ← Satisfies: sc-1
- A contract test asserts that conflict_resolver never proposes a (write, dso-id) mutation; the test inspects conflict_resolver output across the 6-case test matrix from draft-9 ← Satisfies: sc-7, sc-11
- A static guard in the applier matrix raises a DsoIdLabelWriteError if any code path attempts to write a dso-id label outside the two authorized paths ← Satisfies: sc-1, sc-7
- Unit tests written and passing for all new logic ← Validates Closure Check: "TDD DoD"

## Considerations

- [Architecture] The single-writer contract is the cheapest defense against rebinding regressions; treat as non-negotiable invariant.
- [Test design] The 9-leaf x dso-id-write test matrix is small enough to be exhaustive — no sampling shortcuts.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a reconciler developer, I want a single-writer contract for dso-id label operations across draft-2, draft-6, draft-9
